title: Remain single-region with tested cross-region DR through 2026
decision: Defer active-active multi-region ingestion. Remain single-region with tested cross-region disaster recovery through 2026; revisit in Q1-2027.
rationale: The elena.sokolova/niko.xu active-active proposal was considered and not adopted. Projected 30-45% infrastructure cost increase is not justified this year: INC-2026-0311 was a deploy regression, not a regional failure, so it is not evidence for active-active. We will harden quarterly DR failover instead and reassess in Q1-2027.

title: Adopt hosted status page vendor instead of building our own
decision: Adopt a hosted third-party status page rather than building and operating an in-house status page.
rationale: Reverses the earlier build decision. A self-hosted status page shares failure domains with the very systems it reports on, and the maintenance cost is not worth it at our scale. A hosted page stays up when we are down.

title: Build an in-house status page
decision: Build and self-host a status page tightly integrated with internal telemetry.
rationale: Original intent was tighter integration with internal monitoring. Reversed by DEC-2026-002 after concluding a self-hosted page shares failure domains with production and cannot be trusted during an outage.

title: Approve data retention policy v3.2 (395-day total)
decision: Approve data retention policy v3.2: 90 days hot + 305 days cold = 395 days total raw-event retention. Supersedes the v3.0 draft (365 days), which is not adopted.
rationale: Legal and Finance settled on 395 days to cover the full dispute-and-audit window. The v3.0 draft's 365-day figure was never ratified.

title: Retire v0 batch API limit; standardize on 1,000 events per batch
decision: The v0 batch limit of 500 events per request is retired (v0 sunset 2025-12-31). The current limit is 1,000 events per batch request.
rationale: Consolidate on the v1 limit across all product docs and KB pages. Any source stating 500 is describing the deprecated v0 behavior.

title: Sable Financial March invoice dispute — issue credit memo
decision: Issue a credit memo against the disputed March invoice INV-202603-0063 for Sable Financial (ACCT-1013). Recognized ARR for the account is adjusted down to 141000 in the GL. The CRM contract-list figure of 150000 is not the recognized figure.
rationale: The March ingestion incident (INC-2026-0311) affected Sable's metered usage; a credit was warranted. Finance GL is the system of record for the recognized figure.

title: Pursue SOC 2 Type II attestation in 2026
decision: Commit to a SOC 2 Type II examination covering the 2026 observation window.
rationale: Enterprise prospects increasingly require it in security review. Scope is the usage-analytics platform and its supporting corporate IT.

title: Standardize customer-facing incident comms on the hosted status page
decision: All customer-facing incident communication routes through the hosted status page as the single source of truth for external incident state.
rationale: Follows DEC-2026-002. Removes ambiguity between email updates and the status page during incidents.
